cli.syntax:
Syntax:
enableLoopback [--lang CODE] [-all | -none | -allow NAME... | -deny NAME... | ?]
enableLoopback [manual] [-registry] [--lang CODE]

-all: Exempt all AppContainers.
-none: Clear all exemptions.
-allow NAME: Add AppContainers whose names contain NAME.
-deny NAME: Remove matching exemptions; * removes all.
Commands ignore case; the leading - or / is optional.
NAME may contain spaces. Use * to match all.
Languages: en, zh-cn, zh-tw, ja, ko, ru.
manual: Skip automatic refresh. -registry: Read the registry directly.
cli.missing_name: Specify part of a name. Use * to match all.
